content: Human-labeling session — def-position-revealed-direction:hard seed 1. Objective: Same scout-then-fortify chain, but your base spawns NORTH (y=14) or SOUTH (y=26) by seed and the threat comes from the corridor on that side. Identify your latitude from your construction yard, scout that corridor, plant three pillboxes at THAT corridor's mouth (around x=22, y≈8 if your base is north of centre, y≈32 if south), then kill three. Yard alive, one unit alive, within about 40 turns. Always-defend-north loses every south-seed run.
